primer: What BrightSpring Does: BrightSpring Health Services (NASDAQ: BTSG ) is a $14.20B US specialty pharmacy and home clinical services platform . After selling ResCare Community Living for $835M in March 2026, it operates two focused segments . Pharmacy Solutions drives ~88.7% of FY2025 revenue via Onco360 oncology pharmacy (155+ Limited Distribution Drugs), home infusion, and PharMerica long-term care . Provider Services (~11.3% of revenue) delivers home health, hospice, and rehab across ~30 states .
